territorial_scope.description: Applies to activities on road sections and areas designated within the administrative area of Pudong New Area.

evidence.quote: 本规定适用于在浦东新区行政区域内划定的路段、区域开展无驾驶人智能网联汽车道路测试、示范应用、示范运营、商业化运营等创新应用活动以及相关监督管理工作。

summary.short: Pudong New Area regulation, in force 1 February 2023, governing road testing, demonstration and commercial operation of driverless intelligent connected vehicles on designated roads and areas. Enterprises must obtain safety self-declaration confirmation, plates and operating certificates, carry insurance, and meet remote-monitoring, data-reporting and accident duties.
summary.long: The regulation governs driverless intelligent connected vehicles (no driver or safety operator on board) in road sections and areas designated in Pudong New Area, covering road testing, demonstration application, demonstration operation and commercial operation under a graded, risk-based approach (Arts. 1-3, 18). Enterprises must obtain confirmation of a safety self-declaration after review by government bodies with third-party institutions and experts (Arts. 5-10), meeting requirements on legal status, remote monitoring, emergency takeover staff and insurance (Art. 6). Vehicles must meet minimal-risk and functional-safety requirements and complete staged road testing (Arts. 7-9). Confirmed vehicles obtain temporary plates (Arts. 12-13); commercial operation requires transport qualifications and operating certificates (Arts. 15-16). Enterprises must report software upgrades and faults, upload data to municipal platforms, keep fault and accident records for at least a year, meet network and data security duties, and store important data domestically (Arts. 17, 21-27). The enterprise first pays for damage attributed to the vehicle, subject to recourse (Art. 29). Non-compliance can lead to suspension, rectification or termination (Arts. 31-32); the text states no monetary fines.

notes: The text sets no numeric thresholds: mileage, time, manual takeover rate and similar values are referred to as 规定里程, 规定值 or 规定 and are delegated to rules not contained in this text. Enforcement under Arts. 31-32 is by suspension, rectification, termination and invalidation of plates and permits; no penalty amounts are stated. Art. 33 provides that rules for unmanned delivery and cleaning equipment are made by Pudong and Lingang authorities under municipal guidance, which is not in the text. The text names no enabling statute; its legal basis and cross-references to traffic, network and data security law are general. Relations and entities are coded from the operative provisions only.
